host.ask: Address of the MultiVu PC running the MultiPyVu server
host.help: On the MultiVu PC run `python -m MultiPyVu -get_ip` (MultiPyVu prints the address) or read it from the server window. Use 127.0.0.1 if this package runs on the MultiVu PC itself.

port.ask: TCP port the MultiPyVu server listens on
port.help: 27183 unless the server was started with another port; both ends must agree.

platform.ask: Which cryostat this is: ppms, dynacool, mpms3, versalab or opticool
platform.help: Decides which MultiPyVu options are offered: the persistent/driven magnet mode exists on a PPMS only; the chamber commands are not used on an OptiCool.
